recommendation: Build the training packet as a single accessible PDF with one section per module, in this order: account setup, data handling, incident reporting. Start with a short overview page listing the three modules, the July 8 date, and how to request an alternative format. Use real document structure: tagged PDF, logical heading levels (H1 for the packet, H2 for each module, H3 for subsections), a reading order that matches the visual order, and descriptive link text (not 'click here'). Provide alt text for every diagram or screenshot and do not rely on color alone to convey meaning. Keep text legible with good contrast. Because several cohort members use screen readers, test the final PDF with a screen reader before distribution. Also offer the packet in at least one alternative format (for example, an accessible Word or plain-text version) on request, so the full cohort of 32 can use it. Coordinate final accessibility review with the accessibility services team.
